title: No carbs in AAPS if phone restart during bolus started via wizard
body:
I entered carbs in wizard and started bolus injection. During the bolus, I had to restart the phone. Once restarted, I actualized pod status to validate the sent bolus.

I can see the bolus but there is no trace of the carbs in AAPS.

![Screenshot_20220225-122218_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/155711501-07c1c3f1-efb6-4a2f-b319-f9bae19dad28.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220225-122228_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/155711520-6d4ad986-f955-4a40-a66b-a23813982042.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220225-122253_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/155711559-40085fb6-d94a-4b2b-a8f3-d30019e6ae3d.jpg)

I don't know if the logs are reset after reboot...

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1645788190507.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8140929/AndroidAPS_LOG_1645788190507.log.zip)

comments.body: carbs are recorded only if bolus is delivered successfuly. it's for safety because people entered carbs for 2nd time when repeated bolus

@MilosKozak When the phone booted, the bolus was "unsure" in the DASH tab. When I actualized it, the fact that the bolus was injected totally was known to AAPS.
I don't know if it will be doable to find a logic that adds carbs if they are missing or to show a message "check carbs and bolus" after boot if AAPS stopped before the bolus complete (the DASH tab new that it hadn't received the "bolus injected ok" message).
carbs info is store donly in memory until bolus is finished
